2025-02-02 | 486 m MD | Girujan | stuck_pipe | medium | 6.2 hrs NPT
Cause: Differential sticking in Girujan, no rotation or reciprocation possible.
Remedy: Reduced mud weight, spotted spotting fluid across pay zone, freed string on jarring.

2025-02-03 | 567 m MD | Girujan | stuck_pipe | medium | 2.7 hrs NPT
Cause: Pipe stuck while tripping through Girujan, unable to work free, torque and drag increasing prior to stic
Remedy: Worked pipe with max overpull, spotted 90 bbl pipe-lax pill, freed after 2.7 hrs.

2025-02-05 | 1416 m MD | Tipam | gas_show | high | 32.8 hrs NPT
Cause: Background gas rise while drilling Tipam, connection gas trending up.
Remedy: Increased mud weight slightly, monitored trend, continued drilling.

2025-02-11 | 3161 m MD | Sylhet | mud_loss | low | 1.4 hrs NPT
Cause: Total losses encountered in Sylhet, no returns to surface for 1.5 hrs.
Remedy: Pumped cement plug to seal loss zone, waited on cement, tested integrity before resuming.
